The composition root signs and packages the feature-owned installer-canary manifest with the host application key; host instrumentation needs the feature data and domain test dependencies. App Zygote acquisition instrumentation also consumes the SELinux domain from the installed host.
Exercises the signed canary against the actual installed application, whose application ID, signing key, asset and version are required for self-update semantics.
Opt-in integration coverage needs the actual installed host and its SDK App Zygote preload; assertions remain test-only and the generic detector smoke test stays independent.

Runtime instrumentation verifies SELinux Raw and DirtySepolicy compatibility inside the installed host's App Zygote preload; the dependency is test-only and cannot run equivalently in a standalone feature module.
